messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-api high 5xx rate detected in us-west-2 (svc=inference-api) — 11% 5xx over 3m. Pager routed to alice-oncall and bob-sre. https://ops.redwood/internal/alerts/2450009876

alice-oncall: ack, joining bridge now. tagging @carla-support for customer impact info

bob-sre: joining. initial suspicion: sudden thundering of long-context requests -> KV pressure. grabbing logs

carla-support: we have 3 customers reporting degraded responses (timeouts then 500s). CS has acknowledged and sent temporary comms to customers A+E. No legal escalation yet.

deepa-eng: looking at model pool, some pods reporting OOM-ish errors in the GPU driver logs around same time. sharing snippet:
```
kubelet: container killed due to out-of-memory: inference-worker-42
[nvidia] driver: gpu-reset observed
```

eli-monitoring: metric view: cpu/gpu utilization moderate, but p95 latency spikes correlate with a retry storm on embeddings route. Key metric: inference_request.retry_count spiked from 0.2->3.1

bob-sre: mitigation plan: 1) scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes (short-term), 2) enable model-variant-fallback to small-quant model for non-critical routes, 3) rate-limit per-tenant burst to 200 qps. Applying 1 and 3 now.

alice-oncall: applied RBAC-friendly scaling request to autoscaler, should see nodes spin up in ~2m. enacted tenant burst limit for customers with >95th percentile requests.

incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler scale-up triggered (request id as-autoscale-2450009876).

carla-support: customer A reports transient improvements, still seeing occasional 500s. customer E still impacted at ~10%.

deepa-eng: enabling variant-fallback for embeddings paths; config patch pushed: 
```yaml
service: inference-api
route: /v1/embeddings
fallback_model: small-embed-v2-quant
fallback_policy: immediate-on-5xx
```

eli-monitoring: after rate-limit + fallback, 5xx rate down to 2.5% in last 5m. p95 latency improving.

bob-sre: good. moving to containment->remediation. root cause hypothesis: long-context customer requests exhausted KV index memory leading to GPU resets and retries.

alice-oncall: recording action items: 1) postmortem ticket, 2) follow-up to add tenant burst protection to default policy, 3) adjust paging thresholds for retries, 4) runbook update. Assigning owners below.

frank-pm: flagging for postmortem priority: customers impacted + potential SLA hit. prefer SLT notification if postmortem > sev2 threshold.

carla-support: action 1: I will create the incident ticket INT-789 and add customer comms notes.

bob-sre: action 2 & 4: I'll own patch to default burst protection and runbook edits (PR queued). ETA EOD tomorrow.

deepa-eng: action 3: propose alert tuning changes — current alert pages on 5xx > 1% for 3m. we should avoid paging on small blips caused by retries. Proposal: change to 5xx_rate > 3% for 5m OR 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m with accompanying error-volume threshold > 50req/min. Draft rule below:
```yaml
- alert: InferenceApiHigh5xx
  expr: sum(rate(inference_api_5xx_total[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_api_requests_total[5m])) > 0.03
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: /runbooks/inference-5xx
```

eli-monitoring: agree on combined ratio+volume check. also add dedupe window for repeated identical alerts (10m) to reduce noise.

alice-oncall: scheduling postmortem: suggested slot tomorrow 10:30 PT. owners: bob-sre (root cause), deepa-eng (fixes), carla-support (customer impact), eli-monitoring (alerts). frank-pm to chair.

frank-pm: 10:30 PT works for me. I'll create calendar invite and include SLT where appropriate.

carla-support: customer comms follow-up: sending update template to impacted customers now; will include mitigation steps and ETA for full remediation.

deepa-eng: small follow-up: add a short-term metric to dashboards: per-tenant rolling qps + long-context ratio so we can spot noisier tenants pre-failure. I'll add that during remediation sprint.

bob-sre: temporary mitigation notes for postmortem: - implemented tenant rate-limits, - enabled fallback to small model, - scaled pool +2 nodes. need follow-up to validate performance/regression on fallback model.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: containment achieved, 5xx rate stable ~1.1% after mitigations. Paging suppressed.

alice-oncall: closing bridge in 10m unless regressions. postmortem ticket INT-789 created: https://issues.redwood/INT-789. Assigned as discussed.

frank-pm: owner checklist for postmortem doc: timeline, root cause evidence, mitigation timeline, post-incident action tracker, SLA impact summary, retro blameless notes. add ticket references.

eli-monitoring: immediate followups for monitoring team: 1) deploy alert rule change (drafted), 2) enable dedupe window, 3) add per-tenant qps metric to operations dashboard. I'll open monitoring PRs today.

carla-support: I'll schedule a customer follow-up 24h after fix to confirm stability and close support cases.

deepa-eng: noted. Also proposing we add a canary policy for long-context traffic to avoid large sudden spike to main pool (discussion in postmortem).

bob-sre: tagging any owners in INT-789 with estimated timelines. will link logs and kernel traces.

alice-oncall: thanks everyone. recap will go in INT-789 and we'll run the postmortem tomorrow 10:30 PT. if anything flares up ping me directly. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INT-789 -> status: contained. Bridge closed.
